name: @mandate/live-agents
description: Buildathon Milestone B.5: the Live AI Lab. Model-backed agents act autonomously under a Portfolio Mandate the principal authors live; the frozen Portfolio Mandate (Phase 7F) remains the only authorization boundary. Models return candidate ids and amounts from closed sets; trusted local code builds, signs and hands every proposal to the real screening, Mandate Room, Portfolio Verifier and ledger. Emits the MANDATE_LIVE_AI.V1 event stream.
